verdict.rationale: Caption export is a fair question for a transcription API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an SRT or VTT export endpoint or path. The mention of powering 'live captions' over streaming describes a real-time use case, not a subtitle-file export format, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export a transcript as SRT or VTT captions through the API or a documented path
